summary: This bill amends the Clean Air Act to bar the EPA from shifting renewable fuel blending obligations from exempt small refineries onto other fuel producers or importers when setting annual Renewable Fuel Standard volumes.

The bill directly amends Section 211(o) of the Clean Air Act to prohibit reallocation of renewable fuel obligations from exempt small refineries under the Renewable Fuel Standard. The RFS itself is an environmental regulation designed to increase renewable fuel use and reduce emissions. By blocking reallocation, the bill prevents the mandate's requirements from being shifted to other obligated parties, thereby reducing the overall stringency and reach of this environmental regulation.
